messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: 5xx spike detected on /v1/generate for model_variant=open-4q-128. 5m error rate 12% (>5% threshold). auto-escalation to oncall.

sara: seeing it too, requests/sec steady but error rate up. traces point to kernel timeouts during matmul. repeatable on few hosts.

arjun: pinging runtime team. can we temporarily reduce traffic to open-4q-128? it's the quantized path we rolled out last week.

tia: i can cut variant weight via admin API. suggest weight->0 and route to open-4b-fp16 stable. also enable per-customer rate limits to avoid noisy tenants.

samir: +1. quick checklist: 1) set weight 0 2) enable global QPS cap 3) confirm downstream latency/backpressure

sara: oncall handoff in ~15m — i'll start mitigation now and add notes for whoever takes over.

ops-bot: Command queued: infractl models set-variant-weight --model open-4q-128 --weight 0 --session=hotpatch-1793034567

arjun: executing: 
```
infractl models get-status open-4q-128
infractl models set-variant-weight --model open-4q-128 --weight 0 --reason "hotpatch: 5xx spike"
```

arjun: weight set to 0 across all regions. routing now diverting ~100% to open-4b-fp16. monitoring.

sara: enabling soft rate-limit at gateway: `rlctl set global qps 12000 --burst 2000 --reason hotpatch` — reduces bursty spikes.

ops-bot: Rate limit applied. Active connections reduced, error rate trending down.

tia: checking error distribution by customer. only 3 large tenants had >30% of failing requests. suggest temporary quota reductions for those tenants.

csm_ellie: CC'ing account owners for the three affected customers. drafting a short note: "We observed transient errors for requests to open-4q-128; we've temporarily routed traffic to a stable variant and applied protective rate limits. We'll update once fully resolved."

samir: applied tenant quotas: `quotactl set --tenant tenant-42 --qps 2000` etc. No immediate customer-visible throttles beyond slight queuing.

kevin: observability: latency p95 for open-4b-fp16 increased ~10% but within SLO. 5xx across platform dropped from 12% -> 1.1% last 7m.

sara: logging mitigation steps in incident doc. oncall handoff: i'm handing to arjun in 12m. arjun, please monitor for 1hr and coordinate rollback if stable.

arjun: ack. will keep watch, start a slow canary to reintroduce open-4q-128 at weight=5% after 30m if metrics stay good.

ops-bot: Scheduled canary reset at 30m: infractl models set-variant-weight --model open-4q-128 --weight 5 --canary

sara: thanks team. postmortem action items: root cause triage with infra ML, add better kernel timeout retries, add auto-eviction rule for variant-level 5xx spikes, update runbook.

csm_ellie: sent customer notes, offered private postmortem for any customer impacted.

arjun: if canary looks clean, we'll set weight back gradually. if error >2% during canary, we keep it disabled and escalate to ML infra.

sara: closing live mitigation now. moving to follow-up channel for RCA. :white_check_mark:
